description: This is a list of all the available endpoints for the API

api_info.description: Provides information about the API's available endpoints.

GET /api.description: Serves up a json representation of all the available endpoints of the api

auth.description: Provides information about the authentication endpoints.

400.description: Validation error

errors.message: Username must be between 3 and 30 characters

POST /api/auth/login.description: Authenticates a user and returns tokens. Use refreshTokenMode="cookie" for web clients so the refresh token is set as an HTTP-only cookie and omitted from JSON. Use refreshTokenMode="explicit" for non-browser clients that manage secure token storage.

400.description: Missing required fields

errors.message: Either username or email is required

example.message: Too many login attempts, please try again in 5 minutes.

POST /api/auth/refresh-token.description: Refreshes the access token using a valid refresh token and rotates the refresh-token session. Web clients use the HTTP-only cookie plus refreshTokenMode="cookie"; explicit clients send refreshToken and refreshTokenMode="explicit".

400.description: Missing refresh token

POST /api/auth/logout.description: Logs out a user by invalidating their refresh token

400.description: Missing refresh token

POST /api/auth/forgot-password.description: Requests a single-use password reset token and always returns a generic response

exampleResponse.message: If your account exists, a password reset has been processed

400.description: Missing required fields or invalid request

example.message: Either username or email is required

POST /api/auth/reset-password.description: Resets a password with a single-use reset token and revokes existing refresh-token sessions

400.description: Missing fields, invalid token, expired token or consumed token
